params.q: What is the GST rate on restaurant food in India?

search_parameters.q: What is the GST rate on restaurant food in India?

response.markdown:
The GST rate on restaurant food in India is **5% without Input Tax Credit (ITC)** for the vast majority of restaurants — including dine-in, takeaway, quick-service restaurants (QSRs), cloud kitchens, and delivery via platforms like Zomato/Swiggy. [0] [1] [2] [3] [4] [5]

The only exception is **18% GST with ITC**, which applies to restaurants located in "specified premises" — broadly, hotels with a room tariff of ₹7,500 or more per night. [2] [1] [4] [6] [0] [3]

The earlier 12% slab (previously applicable to AC restaurants) was removed under the GST 2.0 reforms effective **22 September 2025**, unifying most restaurant services at 5%. [6]

| Type of Restaurant | GST Rate | ITC |
|---|---|---|
| Standalone (AC or non-AC), dine-in / takeaway | 5% | No |
| QSR / Cloud kitchen / Delivery | 5% | No |
| Restaurant in hotel (room tariff < ₹7,500) | 5% | No |
| Restaurant in hotel (room tariff ≥ ₹7,500) | 18% | Yes |
| Outdoor catering (non-specified premises) | 5% | No |
| Outdoor catering (specified premises) | 18% | Yes |
